mutants.reason: In S_RUN with the comparator good for the whole qualifying period, PGOOD rises one clock early, on the clock where pwm_fall fires and the counter still holds TARGET-1. PGOOD also shows a one-clock pulse on that same clock if the counter is held at TARGET-1 and the comparator or run_active drops right after it.
